notes.title: Angy goes Live on Steam Broadcast!
notes.content:
[h3]Witness highly trained. Angry lemmings. Fighting for their survival. Live! 
Join the livesteam. Ask the devs some questions. Chill. 1v1 Us.

STREAM LINK:

notes.title: Angy Demo is available for free during Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
[h3][b]Play the Angy Demo from 3 - 10.October. Grab a friend and fight online, or locally against each other.[/b] In a mixed map collection combining 3 world themes of abilities and contraptions. After the 10th, the Demo with become unavailable until a later date. 

As the game is still in development. We would like to hear your feedback, to help shape the game going forward. You can reach us on the official discord server, also found in the main game store page.

Social Links:
[url=https://discord.gg/wwF2y7NMR3]Angy Discord[/url]
[url=https://angy.no/]Angy Website[/url]

Have a great Next Fest!
[/h3]
